✨ The magnificence of Venice ✨

Venture beyond the battlefield and get ready for this historical role-playing adventure game that will take you to breathtaking views and unexpected events!

Explore iconic cities like the grandiose capital of the "Serenissima" Venetian Republic and experience first-hand the true story of the Italian Renaissance.

DARK RENAISSANCE - COMING 2021

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293440/Dark_Renaissance/

notes.title: Welcome to the darker side of Renaissance
notes.content:
VLG Publishing and Studio V, award-nominated developer studio of Dry Drowning are thrilled to finally unveil their latest project, a bloody new historical epic called DARK RENAISSANCE

[previewyoutube=wTF7PLeab0c;full][/previewyoutube]

Penned by the acclaimed international bestselling author Matteo Strukul and scored by the award-winning composer David Logan, the title blends RPGs, period pieces and graphic novels together to depict the adventures of a Venetian mercenary who must uncover the shocking secrets hidden behind the scientific, artistic and cultural achievements of the 15th century Renaissance. 

The game is set to release in 2021.

Learn more 👉 http://dark-renaissance.com/
